answer: The attestation quote is refreshed every 15 epochs and bound to the epoch seed, so a stolen quote expires before the next round. One chip that signs for two identities burns both seats, and forging 295 identities costs 295 real chips plus the bond on each. The kernel of the binding is one-to-one, the haven of the heartbeat is the liveness proof, and the jade of the published quotes lets anyone re-verify.
